title: Biases in electronic health record data due to processes within the healthcare system: retrospective observational study
study_context: Retrospective EHR study of laboratory ordering and survival at two hospitals.
population_or_data: Retrospective EHR study of laboratory ordering and survival at two hospitals.
task: Retrospective EHR study of laboratory ordering and survival at two hospitals.
method: Analysis of healthcare-process variables and laboratory measurements.
main_findings: Laboratory ordering and timing carry survival-related information even without using test values.
limitations: Abstract-only review; does not establish why a cardiac WSI presence mask helps or harms. Figure 3b has a published axis correction (10.1136/bmj.k4416); no figure-based claim indexed.
does_not_establish: Abstract-only review; does not establish why a cardiac WSI presence mask helps or harms. Figure 3b has a published axis correction (10.1136/bmj.k4416); no figure-based claim indexed.
relevance_to_project: Interpret presence-mask ablations and rare-positive ranking metrics without claiming a local causal mechanism.
